tagline: Christian, Jeremy, Ryan, Vinny. Rounds, standings, and who owes who.

arc: Vinny led this thing for thirteen holes and lost it in about twenty minutes.

San Tan was survivable for everyone but Christian, who opened 7-6-6-6 and stood at +10 before the round had really started. Vinny turned in 39, Jeremy 42, Ryan 43 — and Ryan's 43 was a 37 with two haymakers buried in it, a 7 on the 3rd and an 8 on the 481-yard 8th. That 8th is the number one handicap hole and it took a piece out of all four of them; nobody made par.

Superstition is where it turned. Vinny gave a stroke back on the opening par 4 and never found it again, then made 5 on a 105-yard par 3 at the 14th and the lead was gone. Ryan played the nine in +1 with birdies at the 11th and the 15th — the only two red numbers on the entire card — took sole possession at the 14th, and was never caught.
